instructions:
## Task objective

Full 8-benchmark paper-fidelity judge variant: select the best 10,000 samples from LLaVA-665K for LLaVA-1.5-7B and evaluate on all eight benchmarks (HallusionBench, LLaVABench, MMBench, MMMU_DEV_VAL, MMStar, MMVet, MathVista_MINI, OCRBench) with the paper's Qwen3.5-27B LLM judge. Adds the three judge-only benchmarks (MMVet, LLaVABench, MathVista_MINI) on top of the five judge-free benchmarks. Requires a local vLLM Qwen3.5-27B server reachable at judge_api_base; run via scripts/slurm/run_judge_eval_srun.sh, which serves the judge in-container on the eval node.

## Controlled curation loop

Inspect the supplied pool and implement a selection policy in the editable curation workspace. Produce the requested subset with the required schema, run the audit, and submit it through the benchmark CLI. The harness trains the fixed base model using the prescribed recipe and evaluates the checkpoint. Use the returned feedback to revise the selection policy. Do not alter the protected training or evaluation implementation.

## Exact published task configuration

```yaml
task:
  task_id: llava665k_llava_8bench_10k_judge
  goal: >
    Full 8-benchmark paper-fidelity judge variant: select the best
    10,000 samples from LLaVA-665K for LLaVA-1.5-7B and evaluate on all eight
    benchmarks (HallusionBench, LLaVABench, MMBench, MMMU_DEV_VAL, MMStar,
    MMVet, MathVista_MINI, OCRBench) with the paper's Qwen3.5-27B LLM judge.
    Adds the three judge-only benchmarks (MMVet, LLaVABench, MathVista_MINI) on
    top of the five judge-free benchmarks. Requires a local vLLM Qwen3.5-27B server reachable
    at judge_api_base; run via scripts/slurm/run_judge_eval_srun.sh, which serves
    the judge in-container on the eval node.
  target_rows: 10000
  training_stage: finetuning
  model_key: llava-1.5-7b-hf
  model_name_or_path: __MODEL_PATH__
  target_evals:
    - HallusionBench
    - LLaVABench
    - MMBench
    - MMMU_DEV_VAL
    - MMStar
    - MMVet
    - MathVista_MINI
    - OCRBench
  strategy_timeout_seconds: null
  default_submission_dir: curated/final_submission
  training_config:
    num_processes: 1
    timeout_seconds: 36000
  eval_config:
    benchmarks:
      - HallusionBench
      - LLaVABench
      - MMBench
      - MMMU_DEV_VAL
      - MMStar
      - MMVet
      - MathVista_MINI
      - OCRBench
    # Paper judge (Table 16): Qwen3.5-27B served locally, OpenAI-compatible. The
    # judge_api_base must be the full chat-completions URL; run_judge_eval_srun.sh
    # serves the judge on loopback on the eval node. MMVet / LLaVABench /
    # MathVista_MINI require the judge; the other five reuse it as the MCQ /
    # HallusionBench extraction fallback.
    judge_model: Qwen3.5-27B
    judge_api_base: http://127.0.0.1:8001/v1/chat/completions
    offline: true
    timeout_seconds: 28800
    use_vllm: true
    mode: all
    api_nproc: 4
    gpu_id: 0
  dataset:
    dataset_id: llava665k
    local_path: __DATASET_PATH__
    split: null
    image_column: images
    text_column: texts
```

Configuration source: [curation-bench/src/benchmark/tasks/llava665k_llava_8bench_10k_judge.yaml](https://github.com/Jiachen-T-Wang/curation-bench-pro/blob/fb418bc9ce1c52416550ba6abf5968d8d594c760/curation-bench/src/benchmark/tasks/llava665k_llava_8bench_10k_judge.yaml), [Apache-2.0 license](https://github.com/Jiachen-T-Wang/curation-bench-pro/blob/fb418bc9ce1c52416550ba6abf5968d8d594c760/LICENSE).
